subject: sub-010
observation_boundary: Only recordings/anatomy and prior observation-only v2 fit artifacts. Reject opening released source trajectories or generator parameters. No hidden-label evaluation in this stage.

feature.definition: log1p(causal 50-sample population variance / channel training mean variance). Numerical variance floors use 1% of the median positive channel training mean variance; the scale is frozen from the first 60%.
feature.units: Exported sample/model units, not verified biological milliseconds. This is a low-frequency-inclusive envelope proxy, not the clinical high-pass log-power preprocessing of BVEP.
feature.interpretation: Channel activity envelope; not a clinical seizure or SOZ label. No future samples in a feature.

partition: First 60% fit, next 20% validation, final 20% exploratory evaluation. Scores omit the first 50 samples after either boundary so target windows do not share raw samples with the preceding block. Final 20% was already inspected in v2 and is not an independent test.

mechanistic_fit.reuse: Four v2 observation-only candidate trajectories per network, seed 401. Those x0 parameters used only first-60% recording covariance. No new parameter fitting or calibration of sensor gains.
mechanistic_fit.selection: For each candidate, fit the single global time offset by first-60% envelope MSE. Choose the candidate using validation envelope MSE with that frozen offset. Then refit only its offset on the first 80%, save choices, and forecast the final block without reading future observations.
mechanistic_fit.fresh_seed_rule: For each selected network/candidate, simulate two fresh trajectories with identical v2 parameters/priors and unchanged observation scale. Fit each time offset on the first 80% only; predict the final block. Report both individually and their mean prediction. No seed selection.
mechanistic_fit.phase_profile: Report all offset losses, count/range within 5% of the minimum, and boundary optima. This is a profile diagnostic, not a posterior or proof of parameter identifiability.

baselines.damped_trend: OLS slope on last 10 feature points per channel; forecast from last point using summed powers of damping in [0.8,0.95,1.0]; choose damping on validation, refit slope on first 80%.
baselines.autoregression: Shared lag coefficients across channels, channel-specific prefix means; lags [1,5,10], ridge [0.000001,0.001,0.1] times number of training pairs. Reject candidates whose companion spectral radius exceeds 1.000001. Select by validation MSE; refit on first 80% and use persistence if refit is unstable, explicitly reported. Clamp predicted log envelopes at zero.
baselines.comparator: Choose the best baseline on validation, save its identity before final scores. All final forecasts start from the first-80% boundary with no subsequent observation updates.

endpoints.primary: Mean squared channel log-envelope prediction error over the embargoed final block; ratio to validation-selected baseline. Report reference seed, each fresh seed and fresh-seed mean.
endpoints.secondary: MAE and mean-envelope high-activity proxy mismatch. Proxy threshold is midpoint of training 20th/80th percentiles, with episodes of at least 3 feature points. Report onset/offset and boundary censoring; missing episodes remain failures rather than discarded timing errors.
endpoints.provisional_prediction_gate: Reference-seed MSE at least 10% below the selected baseline and both fresh seeds below baseline. Passing is only a development screen, not validation for intervention planning.
endpoints.network_screen: Personal fresh-seed mean-prediction MSE at least 10% below zero-network mean-prediction MSE, in addition to prediction gate. No patient-level statistical inference from one recording.

limits: Approximate phase search in previously fitted stochastic trajectories, not Bayesian state inference or a new mechanistic parameter fit. No altered coupling, intervention selection, clinical downloads, new resources, GPU or other-job changes. Preserve v1/v2 outputs.
